## 12 November: additional arrival and return enquiry witnesses

<a id="november-12-additional-arrival-and-return-enquiry-witnesses"></a>

**Sources on this page:** p182 A, p182 C.

<a id="edition-cases-radio-nov12-seifert-additional-witnesses-november-12-additional-arrival-and-return-enquiry-witnesses"></a>



Printed p182 A and C are additional physical witnesses to two service enquiries already read on p174. They join the reviewed p183 arrival-enquiry copy. Direct comparison of their printed coordinates supplies a bounded recovery without selecting a German language score. The earlier body readings and the previously established p174/p183 complementary evidence retain their credit; these are **two newly reviewed source records, not two newly discovered message contents**.

The **55-slot A source** has a conditional 74-slot comparison model. It adds twenty coordinates from the independent witnesses and excludes one printed slot; all **eleven minimum source maps** remain in the certificate. The **49-slot C source** has a conditional 48-slot comparison model that excludes its final observed X. Each proposal also changes one observed coordinate. The native streams, printed length discrepancies and every cost class remain separate below.

Research, source review and editorial work: **icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro**. The unchanged Nov10–12 key retains the publication credit of George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker. Existing body evidence is in [the Seifert service edition](168.md#edition-cases-radio-seifert) and [the p183 arrival/departure edition](183.md#edition-cases-radio-nov12-arrival-departure-and-car).


**Reviewed source crops:** [p182_AC_reviewed.png](../experiments/nov12_seifert_additional_witnesses/sources/p182_AC_reviewed.png). [File and pixel verification](../sources/reviewed-crops.md#verify).

<a id="edition-cases-radio-nov12-seifert-additional-witnesses-source-only-comparison-model"></a>

#### Source-only comparison model

The p174 B and p183 B sources contain 74 slots each. They agree wherever both supply valid coordinates. Each invalid-glyph position in one has an observed value in the other. Their conservative union therefore gives **74 observed coordinates**, and every one of the 37 complete target pairs occurs in at least one unedited witness. The earlier p174 C/G-like glyph and its alternate G interpretation remain in the original edition; the union uses its conservative mask and p183’s observed D at that location.

The new p182 A source shares its CM v CZ station pair and originating 19.30 label with p174 B. Interception times differ and are retained literally. The matching source body establishes an additional printed witness; a specific retransmission or typesetting mechanism is not inferred.

The bounded comparison permits **one excluded printed slot and one contiguous twenty-coordinate gap**. All **55 × 55 = 3,025** combinations are checked against the independent raw consensus before any plaintext comparison. The objective is the number of conflicting observed coordinates; the kinds of exclusions and fills are counted separately.

All eleven minima put the twenty-slot gap **after the first five source coordinates** and exclude one source slot from **40 through 50**. Every minimum has one observed disagreement: **p182 source 0 V versus the independently observed D**. Among them, **four exclude a masked glyph** and **seven exclude an observed D**.

| Excluded source indices | Maps | Excluded class | Observed substitutions | Printed-mask fills | Added-slot fills | Raw fixed positions |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 40–44 | 5 | Observed D | 1 | 7 | 20 | 11/37 |
| 45–48 | 4 | Printed non-coordinate mask | 1 | 6 | 20 | 11/37 |
| 49–50 | 2 | Observed D | 1 | 7 | 20 | 10/37 |

The equality concerns **observed substitution count**, not a single combined edit score. Excluding a source mask and excluding a valid D remain different operations. The four mask-exclusion aliases have the same unfilled coordinate string but different source maps. Their seven D-exclusion alternatives remain inspectable in full.

For the primary source-48 mask exclusion, the frame arithmetic is **55 − 1 + 20 = 74**. The printed shortfall of nineteen is therefore not represented as nineteen unexplained additions. The twenty inserted coordinates are model slots 5–24 and are all supplied by the independent source consensus.

<details>
<summary>Source and cipher evidence</summary>

**Raw output — conditional 74-slot frame, before any source or added-slot fills:**

```text
WE??S???????????TR??????I??E?A??RX?O?
```

**Edited output — 1 observed substitution, 6 printed-mask fills, 20 source-supported added fills, and 1 separately counted masked-slot exclusion:**

```text
WENNSEIFERTEINGETROFFENBITTENACHRXTOF
```

</details>

**Readable German — the complete edited stream, with spacing and punctuation only:**

> Wenn Seifert eingetroffen, bitte NACHR. TOF.

**Conditional interpretation — additional arrival-enquiry witness:**

The message asks to be notified when Seifert has arrived. NACHR and TOF remain literal; the abbreviation is not expanded in the exact quotation, and no full identity or destination is supplied. The wording was already recoverable from p174 B/p183 B. This record adds a damaged physical witness and its explicitly bounded alignment, rather than new wording selected from context.

Every filled coordinate in the primary model has an observed counterpart in p174 B or p183 B. The V→D disagreement still costs one substitution in p182 A. Independent evidence does not turn that printed V into a free source-mask fill.

The final two minimum maps, excluding source 49 or 50, have the following distinct unfilled diagnostic. Their final edited target is the same, but they require seven source-mask fills rather than six.


</details>

### p182 C

Literal header: `C) CM v CZ (21.25 p.m., November 12th); 21.00; RIZI-56`.

<details>
<summary>Literal source transcription</summary>

**Source transcription — all 49 observed coordinates, including final X:**

```text
VVVFF VDAFA XXVDA XXFAD DXGXV DDAAG DVFDV DXGFA
DAGVX DDAX
```

</details>

The following CZ is transmission control outside the body. The source explicitly advertises **56**, contains **49**, and is compared with an independently printed **48-coordinate** p174 C body. None of those counts is silently substituted for another.

<details>
<summary>Raw decoded text</summary>

**Raw output — native 49-slot diagnostic, with the unpaired coordinate retained separately:**

```text
2TNNFTQCIFU1RXFENIV0MI4E
```

</details>

The native intermediate orphan is **A at source 27**. The conditional model is a separate layer.

All **49 possible single-coordinate exclusions** are compared directly with the p174 C source. The unique minimum within that class excludes **source 48 X** and leaves **one observed mismatch** at source 8: p182 prints F while p174 prints V. The other 47 coordinates agree exactly. This is source evidence for the same short enquiry; the uniqueness claim does not extend to other framing classes or establish why the final X was printed.

Both sources print CM v CZ and the originating 21.00 field. The p174 interception header says 08.11 p.m.; the p182 header says 21.25 p.m. Those literal time expressions are not harmonized.

<details>
<summary>Source and cipher evidence</summary>

**Raw output — conditional 48-slot frame after the explicit final-X exclusion:**

```text
WANNRUECKKUNFTSEIFVRTXRE
```

**Edited output — 1 observed F→V substitution at source 8, plus the separately counted source-48 X exclusion:**

```text
WANNRUECKKUNFTSEIFERTXRE
```

</details>

**Readable German — the complete edited stream, with spacing and punctuation only:**

> Wann Rueckkunft Seifert. RE.

**Conditional interpretation — additional return-enquiry witness:**

The enquiry asks when Seifert will return. The exact RUECKKUNFT and closing RE are retained. A period is used in the quotation so that a question-mark glyph remains reserved for unresolved plaintext. The existing p174 C body already gives this complete text without edits; the new p182 source requires the priced alignment and correction above.

<a id="edition-cases-radio-nov12-seifert-additional-witnesses-reproduction-and-limits"></a>

### Reproduction and limits

[inputs.json](../experiments/nov12_seifert_additional_witnesses/inputs.json) retains the native transcriptions, original headers, image bounds, unchanged key and prior body credit. [certificates.json](../experiments/nov12_seifert_additional_witnesses/certificates.json) includes all 3,025 A alignment prices, all eleven A minimum maps and position domains, all 49 C prices, native orphan coordinates and exact fill/substitution ledgers. The [frozen OCR snapshot](../experiments/nov12_seifert_additional_witnesses/ocr_snapshot.json) preserves the earlier incomplete A OCR and C block.

The [portable verifier](../experiments/nov12_seifert_additional_witnesses/verify.py) reconstructs the source-only consensus, confirms a complete raw-pair witness at every target position, checks the live case’s full displays, and checks exact re-encryption under all 120 global completions of the unchanged partial square. Its missing digit cells never enter these all-letter bodies. Original-PDF checking additionally compares every source crop pixel.

```sh
python experiments/nov12_seifert_additional_witnesses/verify.py --verify
python experiments/nov12_seifert_additional_witnesses/verify.py --verify --pdf /path/to/childs.pdf
```

The alignment minima are conditional on the specified operation classes. They do not establish a unique historical channel error, authorize removal of source glyphs from the diplomatic transcription, or identify a person beyond the observed surname. Previously catalogued p174 and p183 records are not counted again.

## p182 B — Expected return with the literal time-like label 0100

**Edition context:** An expected return and an attempt to obtain a vehicle.

**Related source pages:** [p189 B](189.md#source-p189-b).

<a id="edition-cases-radio-return-time-and-vehicle-attempt-an-expected-return-and-an-attempt-to-obtain-a-vehicle"></a>



**Source review and edition: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.**

Two complete short native bodies report an expected return and discuss obtaining a vehicle. The first is unchanged; the second has four explicitly priced coordinate substitutions. The incomplete spelling RUECKUNFT, the literal 0100 field and the elliptical sense of VERSUCHEN remain visible.


**Reviewed source crops:** [p182_reviewed.png](../experiments/return_time_and_vehicle_attempt/sources/p182_reviewed.png) · [p189_reviewed.png](../experiments/return_time_and_vehicle_attempt/sources/p189_reviewed.png). [File and pixel verification](../sources/reviewed-crops.md#verify).

<a id="source-p182-b"></a>
<a id="edition-cases-radio-return-time-and-vehicle-attempt-p182-b"></a>

### p182 B

**Source transcription — header:** `B) CM v CZ (20.45 p.m., November 12th); 20.20; RIZI-62`

<details>
<summary>Raw decoded text</summary>

**Raw output — every native source slot in printed order, with non-coordinate glyphs masked:**

```text
RUECKUNFTVORAUSSICHTLICH0100XSX
```

</details>

**Readable German — exact nonseparator labels of the unchanged raw output:**

> RUECKUNFT voraussichtlich 0100. S.

**Meaning:** The sender reports an expected return at the literal label 0100. The closing S is not expanded, and this record does not itself identify the returning person or establish a complete itinerary.

**Editorial limits:**

- All 62 printed coordinates decode directly, with no source erasures, substitutions or frame changes. The following CM UM is printed transmission control outside the body.
- RUECKUNFT is retained with only the one K visible in the decoded stream; the standard spelling Rueckkunft would require an extra plaintext letter and is not silently inserted.
- 0100 is preserved as four literal labels. Its interpretation as a time is contextual; the body does not specify a time zone or independently identify the date.
- The neighboring Seifert service exchange does not establish that the abbreviated S here is a particular person.

### Evidence, credit and reproduction

Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier repository OCR and unchanged-key outputs are retained separately. Source review and explicit editorial work: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.

The certificates independently reconstruct column positions and domains, compare them with the cipher implementation, replay every priced change, and check all readable nonseparator labels. Partial readings have one consistent injective square/source-mask completion witness that re-encrypts exactly; those witness choices are not historical identifications. Source images are bound to the original PDF by page, rectangle, scale, file digest and pixel digest.

Reproduce with `python experiments/return_time_and_vehicle_attempt/verify.py --verify`. Add `--pdf /path/to/adfgvx-childs.pdf` to check the original PDF and exact source-crop pixels.

### p189 B

**Source transcription — header:** `B) CM v CZ (10.10 a.m., November 14th); RIZI-70`

<details>
<summary>Source and cipher evidence</summary>

**Raw output — every native source slot in printed order, with non-coordinate glyphs masked:**

```text
VERSUCHENI6GENDECNEIWWGENZUBEKOMMEN
```

**Edited output — 4 observed-coordinate substitutions and 0 source-mask fills; no insertion, deletion or reordering:**

```text
VERSUCHENIRGENDEINENWAGENZUBEKOMMEN
```

</details>

**Readable German — exact nonseparator labels of the edited output:**

> Versuchen, irgendeinen Wagen zu bekommen.

**Meaning:** The message concerns trying to obtain a vehicle or wagon. The terse infinitive form alone does not securely distinguish a request to try from a report of an attempt, and Wagen does not by itself identify a specific car or railway wagon.

**Editorial limits:**

- All 70 native coordinates are retained and valid. High-resolution inspection reads the last group of the first row as FGXAV, including a clear X; the earlier low-resolution Y-like impression is not retained as a fictitious source erasure.
- The ordinary-word proposal costs four observed-coordinate substitutions. The literal 6 in I6GENDE… is changed only through an explicit coordinate repair, not through a global reinterpretation of the numeral label.
- The edition does not identify a vehicle, promise that one was obtained, or infer a connection to another service message merely from the word Wagen.

</details>
